mentions.description: This project migrates the author's web application from Google Cloud hosting (costing $200/month) to a self-owned PowerEdge R7625 physical server racked in a nearby colo, running on the author's own IP addresses and ASN.
mentions.problem: The application currently costs $200/month to host on GCP.
mentions.source_excerpt: Project #1: I've been working on migrating an application [1] from GCP (where I pay $200/mo to host it) to a physical server (PowerEdge R7625) I've racked in a colo near me, running on my own IPs/ASN [2] and all that jazz.
